title: Experts disagree on ChatGPT, ChatGPT directory and Codex packages
context:
Chief architect: This is the one real disagreement. The integration-architect wording lets the non-Claude packages change skill names; the issue (Phase 2.4) and the settled scope say they keep today's names and content apart from the version. So the non-Claude hosts build with --publish-prefix paqad and --host-labels strip, and the double build diff plus check_chatgpt_submission prove only the version moved.
